name: Arthur J. Gallagher & Co.

logo.source: en.wikipedia.org infobox logo (Arthur J. Gallagher & Co. logo.svg)

description: Gallagher is the world's third-largest insurance broker by revenue (Business Insurance, June/July 2025, as cited in its 10-K) and one of the largest third-party property and casualty claims administrators. It places insurance and reinsurance for commercial, nonprofit and public-sector clients and advises on employee benefits, and it takes essentially no underwriting risk: the insurers it places business with carry the losses. About 58 percent of revenue is commissions paid by insurers as a percentage of premium, about 30 percent is client fees, and the rest is supplemental and contingent payments from insurers plus interest on client money. A second, separate business handles and settles claims for self-insured corporations and insurers for a fee. The company grows mainly by buying brokers (about 780 acquisitions since 2002, including the $13.8 billion AssuredPartners deal closed August 2025).

employees.note: Approximately 72,000 employees, 47 percent in the U.S. and 53 percent outside; about 77 percent work in brokerage and 15 percent in risk management.

businessLines.name: Brokerage
businessLines.how: Insurers pay commissions as a percentage of the premium on policies Gallagher places (commissions $8,024M), clients pay negotiated fees instead or as well ($2,646M), and insurers add supplemental ($466M) and year-later contingent ($324M) payments tied to volume and profitability; it also earns interest on premium-finance loans and client funds ($732M).

businessLines.name: Risk Management
businessLines.how: Fees (including performance-based fees) for handling and settling property/casualty claims for corporations that self-insure and for insurers; about 59 percent of revenue is workers' compensation claims, 34 percent liability and auto, 7 percent property. About 95 percent of its revenue comes from clients that are not Gallagher brokerage clients.

revenue.note: includes $164M of reimbursed costs; revenue before reimbursements $1,585M

businessLines.revenueNote: includes $164M of reimbursed costs; revenue before reimbursements $1,585M

businessLines.name: Corporate
businessLines.how: Not a revenue line: holds debt interest ($639M), external acquisition costs, FX remeasurement and clean-energy investments.

brands.name: Gallagher Re
brands.note: reinsurance brokerage; the 10-K lists Willis Re (acquired from WTW, closed 2023) among its large acquisitions

brands.name: Gallagher Drive / SmartMarket
brands.note: data analytics and carrier-facing platforms; no revenue disclosed

brands.name: AssuredPartners (acquired 2025-08-18, gross consideration $13.8 billion)
brands.note: Largest acquisition in company history, a U.S. commercial, specialty and benefits broker; revenue not separately reported.
